# Research and conversion design

Use available commercial research tools when needed. Qualify owner access, observed customer friction, transaction economics, fulfillment capacity, feasible scope and measurable demand. Cite source/date. Public traffic estimates are not experiment baselines. Return prospect fit and guarantee eligibility separately as yes/no/unknown with evidence gaps. A weak-looking site establishes neither.

Inspect the incumbent and actual buying path. Separate observed behavior from hypotheses and inaccessible states. Use grounded notes, reviews and owner interviews for buyer language and objections; preserve provenance. Competitor claims are not client facts. For motorsport clients, read niche.md for useful research dimensions. Retrieve client-specific facts and integration constraints from that client’s current project brief; do not carry them into unrelated engagements.

Deliver a concise brief: buyer/task, alternatives, verified advantages, objections/proof, constraints, incumbent strengths, opportunities and missing facts. Synthetic personas are hypotheses, not customer research.

For changes state the problem, behavioral mechanism, segment and metric. Prioritize by plausible impact, confidence and effort without artificial precision. Design discovery, comparison, eligibility, dates, options, terms, inquiry/payment, confirmation and follow-up together across mobile/desktop. Collect information when needed; retain selections through navigation/errors. Provide clear comparisons for undecided buyers and quick routes for committed buyers. Label consultation requests accurately when eligibility/availability needs staff confirmation.

Define coherent typography, imagery, spacing and controls on representative pages before expansion. Review visual craft, copy and functionality separately. Use Copy Reviewer after content strategy and drafting; preserve approved facts and voice.

For acquisition or decision flows, have the existing reviewer explain the intended audience, offer, credible support and next step using the artifact itself. Supply approved requirements but omit the creator's persuasive rationale and desired score. Compare recovered meaning with the brief; identify exact confusing or unsupported passages. Separately assess effort before the intended action and whether required inputs serve that stage. A working form or favorable editorial score does not establish that the journey is worth completing. Reuse the existing review pass rather than automatically adding another reviewer.

When an offer or shared promise changes, identify affected surfaces already in scope, including supporting guides, FAQs, routed inquiry labels and confirmations where relevant. Review their terms and next steps together against the accepted decision; preserve unaffected content. Keep material qualifications near claims, but move internal implementation details out of buyer-facing copy unless they affect the decision. Use Copy Reviewer's existing final-version review after major revisions; do not reuse an earlier score for substantially changed work.

Deliver journey, content/assets, representative screens, integration boundary and acceptance criteria. Proceed with scoped prototypes while labeling unresolved facts; block unsupported production claims from shipping. Review scores do not prove conversion.

For pitches use Sales Pitch Reviewer and the relevant authoring skill. Lead with opportunity. Compare equivalent incumbent/proposal measurements; separate lab performance, judgment, hypothetical economics and measured outcomes.
